changelog: Phase 2 - major security + polish release. Auth session moved from localStorage to httpOnly cookie (XSS payloads can no longer steal your token). IMAP now decodes quoted-printable and base64 email bodies so replies read cleanly instead of showing =3D gibberish. Outbound webhooks (campaign.started, campaign.paused) actually fire now - previously the code path was defined but never called. ListThreads N+1 fixed: 100-thread page went from 200+ SQL queries down to 3.
